columns.comment: Threshold key, e.g. RORWA_HURDLE, EWS_RED_MIN, SLA_STAGE_2_KYC_DOCS.
columns.name: threshold_code

columns.comment: Area: Profitability, Credit, Early Warning, Onboarding, Relationship, Opportunity, Cash & Liquidity, Trade & SCF, Cashflow, Signals or Data Foundation.
columns.name: category

columns.comment: Unit of threshold_value: ratio, usd, score, days, hours, months or count.
columns.name: unit

columns.comment: How it is applied: below, at_or_above, above, at_most or within.
columns.name: comparison

columns.comment: Measure or field the threshold is applied to.
columns.name: applies_to

columns.comment: Where the value comes from: config/smbc_genie.yaml (configurable), silver.kyc_case_stage (stage SLA) or a business rule fixed in gold.
columns.name: source

comment: Single source of business thresholds (D20, D29): profitability hurdles (RoRWA 1.2%, RAROC 12%, ROE 10%; "below hurdle" always means below these configured values), the USD 500m single-borrower attention threshold, EWS bands (Green < 40, Amber 40-69, Red >= 70), covenant headroom warning, onboarding stage SLA days and the cut-offs used by the standard questions (e.g. LTV 70%, 90 days without RM contact). Ratios are fractions (0.012 = 1.2%). Grain: one row per threshold.
